name: Pikchr
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: PIC-like diagram script to SVG; every element placed by direction and distance, no auto-layout
summary: Pikchr is a diagram language from the SQLite author. A text script places boxes, arrows and labels by relative direction and distance, and a single C program emits SVG, so the layout is exactly what the script says and an edit moves only what depends on it. It has no tagged releases and no package: it is built from source (pikchr.y through lemon) with the system C compiler.
use_when: A diagram whose layout stays put between edits; over d2 or graphviz, which re-lay out the whole graph
Small flow, block or sequence diagrams as SVG with no browser or runtime
Authors who think in relative placement and want a diff-friendly text source
avoid_when: Large graphs needing automatic layout: graphviz or d2
Quick flowcharts in familiar Markdown syntax: mermaid-cli
Text styling or fonts that must be pinned in the file: the SVG leaves fonts to the renderer

install.macos: Fetch the pinned check-in tarball from pikchr.org and run `make pikchr` with the system cc (examples/pikchr-flow-svg/run.sh does this inside output/).

notes: 2026-11-27: Lead said no tagged releases and mirror pushed 2026-01-02; the Fossil trunk at fetch time was check-in a7f1c35bc0 of 2026-04-03 (pikchr 1.0 20260403102956). The repository does not commit pikchr.c, so the lead's single-file compile needs the official Makefile (lemon generates pikchr.c from pikchr.y); no npm package or Homebrew formula was used.

2026-11-27: SVG text carries no font-family and the root style is font-size:initial, which resvg 0.47.0 warns about; text still rendered at a readable size in a serif fallback. Pin fonts at the rasteriser.

assessment.rationale: 0BSD; Fossil trunk checked in 2026-04-03; builds with only a system C compiler. Distinct from d2 and graphviz because placement is explicit and edit-stable. Retain as a candidate: no tagged releases and no package route, so the pinned check-in is the version.

evidence.result: Built check-in a7f1c35bc0 in output/ with system cc; four-box flow to SVG (viewBox 0 0 499.68 34.56, 7 paths, 4 labels), identical bytes on repeat; lengthening the last label left the first 5 shapes unchanged and widened the viewBox; resvg 0.47.0 PNG 960x66 inspected.
evidence.scope: One four-box left-to-right flow, pikchr 1.0 built from source on macOS arm64; not other object types, fonts or platforms. resvg warns font-size:initial.
